spots.name: Briežkalns

park.headline: Freestyle / park: no skiable day in the 15-day forecast
lines: Closest call is Mon 30 Nov (score 25/100, 17% of models skiable, cover about 48.4 cm with snowmaking).

To open, Briežkalns needs about 3,960 m³ of machine snow for the central run (about 1,800 m³ of water). With 5 snow guns (2 new fan guns + 3 older guns) that is roughly 39 hours of snowmaking at −5 °C wet-bulb (74 h at −3 °C, 23 h at −10 °C); the snowpark brings the total to 7,298 m³, about 72 hours at −5 °C.

Snowpark ready: no majority date yet - only 3 of 9 models make enough snow in time (those open it Sat 28 Nov to Mon 30 Nov). The rest still lack about 2,664 m³ at the end of their forecast, about 26 more hours at −5 °C wet-bulb.
Natural snow alone does not get there (peak natural cover about 4.6 cm).
First meaningful snowfall: Sat 21 Nov (about 1.7 cm, 73% of models).
Snowmaking weather starts Mon 23 Nov (6.0 h below the wet-bulb limit that day; 105 h across the horizon).

Weeks ahead (low confidence): freezing weeks become more likely than not from the week of Thu 26 Nov (86% of 50 members), and snowmaking-grade cold (week averaging below -3 C) from the week of Thu 24 Dec (56%).
